items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites; reported site-attributed commission of $0 does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost, including 225 errors and 5 transient errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold exists. The pilot result of 70 treatment outputs versus 44 controls is operational activity, not financial or causal lift; treatment also had 58 versus 40 requests and a 12.21 versus 9.39 hour average cycle. Continue only existing reconciliation, repair, validation, measurement, legal, and security work using recorded telemetry. Minimum measurement before reconsidering growth: period-aligned attributable revenue by site/content/tracking ID; reconciled AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budget ceilings; and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn.

Retain SEO, design, affiliate, CRO, and site-factory items as deferred hypotheses only. Do not queue or requeue production work while financial attribution, measurement, failure-repair, release, and security gates remain incomplete. A read-only readiness brief may proceed only where already approved, requires no spend or production mutation, and reports unknown revenue, margin, attribution, and launch economics explicitly.
